privacy.title: Privacy policy
sections: Who we are

Medicos is a pre-visit intake assistant for clinics in India. Before your visit, you tell our AI assistant about your health concern; it organises your own words into a summary for the doctor you choose. The AI does not diagnose, prescribe or advise.
What we collect

Your phone number or email (to log you in), your name, age or date of birth, gender, city and preferred language, the answers you give in the pre-visit chat or by voice, photos or reports you choose to upload, and the notes your doctor finalises.
Why we collect it

Only to prepare your pre-visit summary for the doctor you choose, keep your medical record book, send visit and medicine reminders you can turn off, and keep the service safe. We never sell your data and never use it for advertising.
Who can see it

Only you, and a doctor you choose: when you send a summary to them, book them, or tap Allow after they scan your Medicos ID. Access is time-limited (usually 24 to 72 hours), every view is logged, and you can stop access at any time from "Who can see my records". Clinic receptionists see only visit times and your Medicos ID, never your health information.
AI processing

Before anything is sent to an AI model we remove your name, phone, email, address and Medicos ID. We only use AI providers whose terms forbid training on your data. Voice recordings are transcribed and you confirm the text before it is used.
Where it is stored
In production, health data is stored in India (AWS Mumbai region), encrypted in transit and at rest; names, messages, summaries and doctor notes are additionally encrypted field by field.
How long we keep it

As long as your account is active. You can download your data or ask us to delete your account; deletion completes within 30 days, except records the law requires us to keep (such as billing for doctors).
Your rights (DPDP Act 2023)

You can access, correct and erase your data, withdraw consent, see who accessed your records, and nominate someone to act for you. Contact our Grievance Officer at grievance@medicos.example (to be confirmed before launch).
Children
A parent or guardian creates and manages profiles for children under 18 from their own account.
Changes
If we change this policy we will tell you in the app and ask for consent again when required.

terms.title: Terms of use
sections: Not medical advice
Medicos collects information for your doctor. It is not a diagnosis, prescription or medical advice, and it does not replace seeing a doctor. In an emergency call 112 or go to the nearest hospital.
Your account
Keep your phone or email secure. Give true information and only create profiles for family members you are responsible for.
Doctors

Doctors are verified by Medicos staff before patients can book them. The treating doctor alone is responsible for diagnosis and treatment. AI summaries are drafts that the doctor must review before finalising.
Fees
Patients pay nothing. Doctors and clinics pay the subscription shown in Plan & billing; prices exclude 18% GST.
Acceptable use
Do not misuse the service, try to access other people's data, or upload content that is not yours to share.
Liability
We work hard to keep Medicos available and accurate, but the service is provided as is. To the extent the law allows, Medicos is not liable for clinical decisions made by doctors.
Law
These terms are governed by the laws of India; courts at the company's registered office have jurisdiction.
